title: Velvety Polish Potato Dumplings
description: A traditional Polish dish featuring floury potatoes and a buttery, chewy texture, perfect for a comforting dinner. This recipe is Buddhist-temple-friendly and incorporates char-grill-yang flavors.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the grated potatoes, flour, melted butter, eggs, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and char-grill-yang seasoning.
Mix the ingredients together until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and gently add the dumplings.
Cook the dumplings for 10 minutes or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
